findings.title: Missing group still returns null without invalidating cache
findings.body: getSubGroupsCount() treats a missing delegate as success and returns null, and it never calls registerGroupInvalidation. Sibling paths (isUpdated, getDelegateForUpdate, getRoleMappingsStream) treat a null persistence lookup as "not found" and either throw or invalidate the cached entry. Callers such as GroupUtils.populateSubGroupCount pass this Long straight into the representation; any unboxing (long count = getSubGroupsCount()) still NPEs, and a concurrently deleted group stays in the Infinispan cache so later reads keep hitting the same stale adapter instead of dropping it.

findings.title: Concurrent group test asserts before the reader thread finishes
findings.body: createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti starts an unmanaged Thread that shares managedRealm.admin() (the admin client is not thread-safe) and only flips deletedAll after deletes. The assertion on caughtExceptions runs immediately, with no join, timeout, or happens-before with the reader. The reader can still be inside groups() or about to record an exception when the assert runs, so the test can pass while the NPE is still in flight, and a late failure is lost. The loop can also exit before a single overlapping read occurs, and groups(..., brief=true) is not shown to call getSubGroupsCount, so this does not reliably cover the NPE the PR claims to fix.
